summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K and Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return for May 29, 2026, reporting a share buyback of 374,400 ordinary shares at a price of USD 3.1467 per share, representing 0.0302% of existing shares. The issuer has repurchased shares for cancellation, pending final cancellation. The filing is a routine post-trade disclosure for an open-market repurchase program — a capital return via buyback. There are no premiums, advisors, or structural complexities. Watch for continued buyback activity and impact on share count.
